chapterInfo.content:
2
Efeso nwoma
1 # Adi 1.13; 1.16; 1.20 Efeso asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na deɛ ɔkura nsoromma nson ne nifa mu, deɛ ɔnam sika nkaneadua nson no mfimfini no seɛ: 2#Adi 2.9; 2.13; 2.19; 3.1; 3.8; 3.15; 1 Yoh 4.1 Menim wo nnwuma ne wo brɛ ne wo boasetɔ, ɛne sɛ wontumi nkura wɔn a wɔyɛ abɔnefoɔ, na woasɔ wɔn a wɔse wɔyɛ asomafoɔ na wɔnyɛ no ahwɛ, na woahu wɔn sɛ atorofoɔ. 3Na wowɔ boasetɔ, na me din nti, woahunu amane, nanso woampa aba. 4Nanso mewɔ wo ho asɛm bi, ɛne sɛ, woagya wo kane dɔ no. 5#Adi 2.16; 2.22; 3.3; 3.19 Enti kae deɛ wofiri hwee aseɛ, na sakyera w’adwene, na yɛ kane nnwuma no! Anyɛ saa a, mɛba wo so na mabɛyi wo kaneadua mafiri ne siberɛ, gye sɛ wosakyera w’adwene. 6#Dwom 139.21; Adi 2.15 Nanso yei na wowɔ, sɛ wotan Nikolaifoɔ nnwuma a me nso metan no. 7#Adi 2.11; 2.17; 2.26; 3.5; 3.12; 3.21; 22.2; Gye 2.9; 3.22; 3.24 Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no: Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛma no nkwadua a ɛsi Nyankopɔn paradise mu no aba bi adi.
Smirna nwoma
8 # Adi 1.11; 1.17-18 Na Smirna asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na ɔkannifoɔ ne okyidifoɔ, deɛ ɔwuiɛ na ɔte ase bio no seɛ: 9#Yak 2.5; Adi 3.9; 2 Ko 11.14-15 Menim w’ahohia ne wo hia no, nanso woyɛ ɔdefoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔse wɔyɛ Yudafoɔ, nanso wɔnyɛ, na mmom wɔyɛ Satan hyiadan no abususɛm. 10#Mat 10.28; Adi 3.11; 2 Ti 4.8 Nsuro amaneɛ a worebɛhunu biara. Hwɛ, ɔbonsam de mo mu binom bɛgu afiase, na wɔasɔ mo ahwɛ, na mobɛhunu amane dadu. Di nokorɛ kɔduru owuo mu, na mɛma wo nkwa abotire. 11#Adi 20.14 Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no: Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, owuprenu renka no.
Pergamo nwoma
12 # Adi 1.16; Yes 49.2; Heb 4.12 Na Pergamo asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na deɛ ɔkura afena anofanu nnamnnam no seɛ: 13#Adi 13.2; 3.8 Menim faako woteɛ, deɛ Satan ahennwa sie, na wokura me din mu, na woampa me gyidie, nna a wɔkumm me danseni nokwafoɔ Antipa wɔ mo hɔ no mu, deɛ ɔbonsam teɛ hɔ. 14#Num 31.16; Yuda 11 Nanso mewɔ wo ho nsɛm kakra: Sɛ wowɔ nnipa wɔ wo hɔ a wɔkura Bileam nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, deɛ ɔkyerɛɛ Balak sɛ ɔnto Israel mma suntidua na wɔnni nam a wɔakum ama abosom, na wɔmmɔ adwaman no. 15#Adi 2.6 Saa ara nso na wowɔ wɔn a wɔkura Nikolaifoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu. 16#Adi 1.16 Enti sakyera w’adwene! Anyɛ saa a, mɛba wo so ntɛm, na mede m’anomu afena ne wɔn ako. 17#Adi 3.12 Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no: Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛma no mana a ahunta no bi adi, na mɛma no ɔboɔ fitaa, na ɔboɔ no so na wɔatwerɛ din foforɔ bi a obiara nnim, sɛ deɛ ɔnya no nko.
Tiatira nwoma
18 # Adi 1.14-15 Na Tiatira asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na Nyankopɔn Ba a n’ani te sɛ ogyaframa na ne nan te sɛ yaawa fɛfɛ no seɛ: 19Menim wo nnwuma ne wo dɔ ne wo gyidie ne wo som ne wo boasetɔ no ne sɛ wo nnwuma a ɛdi akyire sene deɛ ɛdi kan no. 20#Adi 2.4; 1 Ah 16.31 Nanso mewɔ wo ho asɛm, sɛ woma ɔbaa Isebel a ɔfrɛ ne ho sɛ odiyifoɔ no kwan sɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ na ɔnnaadaa me nkoa na wɔmmɔ adwaman na wɔnni nam a wɔakum ama abosom. 21Na mama no berɛ sɛ ɔmfa nsakyera n’adwene mfiri n’adwamammɔ mu, na wansakyera. 22Hwɛ, mede no bɛto mpa so, na mede wɔn a wɔne no sɛe awadeɛ no magu ahohia kɛseɛ mu, gye sɛ wɔasakyera wɔn adwene wɔ wɔn nnwuma mu. 23#Dwom 7.9; Yer 17.10 Na mede owuo bɛkum ne mma, na asafo no nyinaa ahunu sɛ, mene deɛ ɔhwehwɛ adwene ne akoma mu, na mɛma mo mu biara sɛdeɛ mo nnwuma teɛ. 24Na mese mo a moaka Tiatira no, dodoɔ a wɔnni saa nkyerɛkyerɛ yi, wɔn a wɔnhunuu Satan bunu mu, sɛdeɛ wɔka no no, sɛ: Merensoa mo adesoa foforɔ. 25#Adi 3.11 Nanso deɛ mowɔ no, monsɔ mu den nkɔsi sɛ mɛba.
26 Na deɛ ɔdi nkonim ne deɛ ɔkura me nnwuma mu kɔsi awieeɛ no,
mɛma no amanaman so tumi,
27 # Adi 12.5; Dwom 2.8-9 na ɔde dadeɛ poma bɛyɛne wɔn,
na ɔbɛbobɔ wɔn sɛ ɔnwomfoɔ nkukuo,
28 sɛdeɛ me nso menyaeɛ wɔ m’Agya nsa mu no; na mɛma no adekyeeɛ nsoromma no. 29#Adi 3.6; 3.13; 3.22 Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no.

Efeso asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na deɛ ɔkura nsoromma nson ne nifa mu, deɛ ɔnam sika nkaneadua nson no mfimfini no seɛ: Menim wo nnwuma ne wo brɛ ne wo boasetɔ, ɛne sɛ wontumi nkura wɔn a wɔyɛ abɔnefoɔ, na woasɔ wɔn a wɔse wɔyɛ asomafoɔ na wɔnyɛ no ahwɛ, na woahu wɔn sɛ atorofoɔ. Na wowɔ boasetɔ, na me din nti, woahunu amane, nanso woampa aba. Nanso mewɔ wo ho asɛm bi, ɛne sɛ, woagya wo kane dɔ no. Enti kae deɛ wofiri hwee aseɛ, na sakyera w’adwene, na yɛ kane nnwuma no! Anyɛ saa a, mɛba wo so na mabɛyi wo kaneadua mafiri ne siberɛ, gye sɛ wosakyera w’adwene. Nanso yei na wowɔ, sɛ wotan Nikolaifoɔ nnwuma a me nso metan no. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no: Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛma no nkwadua a ɛsi Nyankopɔn paradise mu no aba bi adi.

Na Smirna asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na ɔkannifoɔ ne okyidifoɔ, deɛ ɔwuiɛ na ɔte ase bio no seɛ: Menim w’ahohia ne wo hia no, nanso woyɛ ɔdefoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔse wɔyɛ Yudafoɔ, nanso wɔnyɛ, na mmom wɔyɛ Satan hyiadan no abususɛm. Nsuro amaneɛ a worebɛhunu biara. Hwɛ, ɔbonsam de mo mu binom bɛgu afiase, na wɔasɔ mo ahwɛ, na mobɛhunu amane dadu. Di nokorɛ kɔduru owuo mu, na mɛma wo nkwa abotire. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no: Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, owuprenu renka no.

Na Pergamo asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na deɛ ɔkura afena anofanu nnamnnam no seɛ: Menim faako woteɛ, deɛ Satan ahennwa sie, na wokura me din mu, na woampa me gyidie, nna a wɔkumm me danseni nokwafoɔ Antipa wɔ mo hɔ no mu, deɛ ɔbonsam teɛ hɔ. Nanso mewɔ wo ho nsɛm kakra: Sɛ wowɔ nnipa wɔ wo hɔ a wɔkura Bileam nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, deɛ ɔkyerɛɛ Balak sɛ ɔnto Israel mma suntidua na wɔnni nam a wɔakum ama abosom, na wɔmmɔ adwaman no. Saa ara nso na wowɔ wɔn a wɔkura Nikolaifoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu. Enti sakyera w’adwene! Anyɛ saa a, mɛba wo so ntɛm, na mede m’anomu afena ne wɔn ako. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no: Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛma no mana a ahunta no bi adi, na mɛma no ɔboɔ fitaa, na ɔboɔ no so na wɔatwerɛ din foforɔ bi a obiara nnim, sɛ deɛ ɔnya no nko.

Na Tiatira asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na Nyankopɔn Ba a n’ani te sɛ ogyaframa na ne nan te sɛ yaawa fɛfɛ no seɛ: Menim wo nnwuma ne wo dɔ ne wo gyidie ne wo som ne wo boasetɔ no ne sɛ wo nnwuma a ɛdi akyire sene deɛ ɛdi kan no. Nanso mewɔ wo ho asɛm, sɛ woma ɔbaa Isebel a ɔfrɛ ne ho sɛ odiyifoɔ no kwan sɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ na ɔnnaadaa me nkoa na wɔmmɔ adwaman na wɔnni nam a wɔakum ama abosom. Na mama no berɛ sɛ ɔmfa nsakyera n’adwene mfiri n’adwamammɔ mu, na wansakyera. Hwɛ, mede no bɛto mpa so, na mede wɔn a wɔne no sɛe awadeɛ no magu ahohia kɛseɛ mu, gye sɛ wɔasakyera wɔn adwene wɔ wɔn nnwuma mu. Na mede owuo bɛkum ne mma, na asafo no nyinaa ahunu sɛ, mene deɛ ɔhwehwɛ adwene ne akoma mu, na mɛma mo mu biara sɛdeɛ mo nnwuma teɛ. Na mese mo a moaka Tiatira no, dodoɔ a wɔnni saa nkyerɛkyerɛ yi, wɔn a wɔnhunuu Satan bunu mu, sɛdeɛ wɔka no no, sɛ: Merensoa mo adesoa foforɔ. Nanso deɛ mowɔ no, monsɔ mu den nkɔsi sɛ mɛba.
Na deɛ ɔdi nkonim ne deɛ ɔkura me nnwuma mu kɔsi awieeɛ no,
mɛma no amanaman so tumi,
na ɔde dadeɛ poma bɛyɛne wɔn,
na ɔbɛbobɔ wɔn sɛ ɔnwomfoɔ nkukuo,
sɛdeɛ me nso menyaeɛ wɔ m’Agya nsa mu no; na mɛma no adekyeeɛ nsoromma no. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
